title: ActivityActionKind
description:
One explicit user activity action (`activity.action`).

This is the single write entry of the activity panel; the UI confirms destructive actions inline before sending, and the host re-checks the current state (a job/subagent/schedule may have finished in between).

oneOf.description: Stop one running background job (explicit user action, no approval).
Interrupt one running subagent of the current conversation.
Delete one workspace schedule (host pre-checks the id through `list`).
